_readme: Request skeleton for `aivoice_cover.py --json-file`. Copy it, replace the
placeholders, and delete the _readme key. The placeholder values below are
input    : a local audio path (mp3/wav/flac/m4a/ogg/aac/wma/mp4) OR omit it
and use `source` for a public http(s) mp3 URL.
voice_id : a voice_id that is present and enabled in your config/voices.json.
Run `--list-voices` to see the ids registered on your machine.
options  : optional; reverb is one of 关闭 | 录音棚 | 现场 (or true/false).
Only process audio you are authorized to use. See docs/DISCLAIMER.md.
